notes: 1932 Chamber of Deputies election (30 Oct 1932), 142 seats in 24 agrupaciones departamentales; the 7.a (Santiago, 28 seats) is split into three electoral districts with separate lists and seat distributions, transcribed as contests 71, 72, 73. Sources: pp4-8 national summary table (lists by party, votes per list, 'Total en la Agrupación', inscritos, diputados elegidos per list) and pp9-40 the Tribunal Calificador's definitive scrutiny per agrupación (lists, candidate preferences by department, proclamation). Where the Tribunal printed a provisional scrutiny followed by a complementary table (3.a, 5.a, 6.a, 13.a, 16.a, 22.a, 24.a), the final figures including the complementary elections of March 1933 are recorded. No null/blank or total-cast figures are printed anywhere: 'valid' is the summary table's 'Total en la Agrupación' of list votes (printed only for whole agrupaciones, so null for the three Santiago districts). 'registered' is the inscritos printed for the agrupación (for Santiago districts, the district inscritos from the page header). national.valid is the printed 'Número total de votantes' 326,701 (= the sum of list votes) and national.registered the total inscritos 464,870 (p8); the volume prints no national party totals. Withdrawn ('Retirada') lists are omitted. Candidate dashes are recorded as 0. Several scans are cut off at the bottom (2.a, 6.a, Santiago 1.er and 3.er distritos, 8.a): missing list totals were taken from the summary table and missing elected candidates are named only where the surviving proclamation names them; see contest notes. pp1-3 are cover/introductory pages. The contests' valid totals (Santiago districts have none) add to 257,412; with Santiago's printed 69,288 that is 326,700, one short of the printed national 326,701.

The 1.er Distrito table (p17) is a poor scan and its bottom edge is cut off: Lista 14 (after its no-preference row), listas 15, 16, 28, 29, 30, the rest of Lista 43 after four candidates, and listas 44 and 45 are missing; their list totals come from the national summary table (p5, re-read at 300 dpi: L15 319, L29 320, L45 413), and the elected candidates of listas 28 and 44 are named (without votes) from the proclamation on p17. Lista 43's printed candidates are partial so its preferences do not sum. Seats from the 'Corresponden' distribution on p17 (L40 5, L28 2, L21 2, L24 2, L33, L43, L3, L19, L5, L31, L44 1 each). No district-level valid total is printed (the summary gives only the whole-agrupación total of 69,288 and 99,034 inscritos); registered is the 1.er Distrito's 70,320 inscritos from the page header. Readings checked against the proclamation text: L21 no-preference 1,411 (Vicuña Fuentes 154 + 1,411 = 1,565 as printed) and Olavarría 589; L39 García Burr read 597 (scan looks like 587; 597 makes the list total 1,021, also printed in the cuocientes). Lista sums that remain off by the printed totals because of illegible digits: L5 (sum 1,955 vs 1,985), L10 (231 vs 232), L11 (792 vs 821), L20 (552 vs 553), L23 (982 vs 981), L25 (279 vs 280), L33 (no-preference read 580; 559 would close it: 2,623 vs 2,602), L38 (811 vs 806), L42 (1,181 vs 1,192). The agrupación total printed on p5 (69,288) less the 2.o and 3.er districts' lists (7,992 and 10,368) leaves 50,928 for this district, but the lists recorded here add to 51,048 (120 more): some list totals are misread or misprinted on these poor scans (candidates: L41 345 here from p17 vs 315 in the summary; L5, L11 and L42 whose preferences don't close). Dashes recorded as 0. Many names are hard to read on this scan.
